summary: Due to the need for improvements in Piñon Flats Campground, sites can be reserved 3 months in advance beginning in 2026.

title: Great Sand Dunes National Park & Preserve: Sand Board and Sand Sled Rentals Not Available In Park.
summary: Sand boarding and sand sled rentals are located in local communities surrounding the park. Visitors are encouraged to arrange rentals BEFORE coming to the park.
place: Great Sand Dunes National Park & Preserve

title: Great Sand Dunes National Park & Preserve: Speed Limits are Much Lower Inside Park than Surrounding Highways
summary: Speed limits for the park include 30 MPH near the park boundary and Great Sand Dunes Sign, and as low as 10 MPH near the Headquarters and Entrance Station. Speed limits are in place to protect park visitors, pedestrians, and wildlife in the park. Please drive carefully and responsibly.
place: Great Sand Dunes National Park & Preserve

title: Great Sand Dunes National Park & Preserve: Great Sand Dunes Currently at Stage 1 Fire Restrictions
summary: As of August 18th, Great Sand Dunes is under Stage 1 Fire Restrictions. All wood and charcoal fires must be in established fire rings in designated campsites or picnic sites. No other open fires are allowed. Fires MUST BE put out COLD before leaving your site and must not be left unattended. camp stoves and other pressurized gas devices allowed.
place: Great Sand Dunes National Park & Preserve

summary: The park weather station measured 1.5 inches of rain overnight on 10/23/2026. Medano Creek is currently flowing at 28 cubic feet per second. title: Great Sand Dunes National Park & Preserve
summary: The tallest dunes in North America are the centerpiece in a diverse landscape of grasslands, wetlands, forests, alpine lakes, and tundra. Stay on a moonless night to experience countless stars in this International Dark Sky Park! Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week year-round. There are no timed entries or reservations to visit.
